notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
Each probe runs with read-only tools in an empty directory. The routing decision is made from the description before any file is read, so the absence of a real repository does not affect it.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Require two-factor authentication for every member of our GitHub organization.
Roll out a ruleset to every repository in our org that is tagged as production.
Restrict which GitHub Actions the repositories in our organization may use.
Review which GitHub Apps are installed in our org and what they can access.
Collect evidence from our GitHub organization's audit log for the SOC 2 auditor.
Turn on secret scanning for this one repository.
Tighten the permissions block in our deploy workflow.
Set up an Azure DevOps project with branch policies.
Write a CODEOWNERS file for this repository.
Explain the difference between a GitHub organization and an enterprise account.
